crashes.title: Crashes in DC
crashes.agency: DDOT / MPD via Open Data DC

method: Each crash since 2022-01-01 is assigned to the nearest HIN corridor whose centerline passes within 25 m (point-to-segment, local equirectangular projection). KSI = people killed + seriously (major) injured. Injuries = all reported injured people (major + minor). Ward(s) are read from the joined crash records. Each corridor carries an `audit` block (date range, join-distance stats, and a sample of CRIMEID record IDs) and `totals` reports fetched/geocoded/joined/excluded counts so the figures are traceable back to source records. Recommended interventions are a screening suggestion ranked by the corridor's own mode mix and severity (each carries its trigger), not a DDOT plan; effect sizes come from data/countermeasures.json (research-grade until verified).
caveats: Counts are crashes within 25 m of the DDOT High Injury Network centerline, 2022-present, from the open, police-reported Crashes in DC dataset; they may differ from DDOT's curated figures. Ungeocoded crashes and crashes off the HIN are excluded. A crash near two corridors is assigned to the nearest.

road_diet.name: Road diet / lane rechannelization
road_diet.effect: FHWA cites ~19-47% total crash reductions for road diets; Seattle's Nickerson St saw roughly -93% aggressive (top-end) speeding.

protected_intersection.name: Protected intersections
protected_intersection.effect: Widely deployed in Vision Zero programs to remove turning conflicts at high-injury intersections; effect varies by site (verify locally).

leading_pedestrian_interval.name: Leading pedestrian intervals
leading_pedestrian_interval.effect: Seattle reported roughly -34% serious-injury/fatal pedestrian crashes and -48% pedestrian turning collisions at LPI locations.

curb_extension.name: Curb extensions / bump-outs
curb_extension.effect: A standard component of low-cost Vision Zero packages (e.g. Hoboken's 60+ curb extensions) credited in its sustained zero-death record.

daylighting.name: Daylighting (clear-sight corners)
daylighting.effect: Core to Hoboken NJ's multi-year stretch with zero traffic deaths, deployed at 130+ intersections alongside high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions.

protected_bike_lane.name: Protected bike lanes
protected_bike_lane.effect: physically separates people biking from traffic

automated_speed_camera.name: Automated speed enforcement
automated_speed_camera.effect: A DDOT study reported injury crashes falling from 841 to 673 (about -20% injuries) around enforced locations; Portland measured -71% to -93% top-end speeding within 30 days of activation.

speed_limit_20.name: 20 mph default speed limit
speed_limit_20.effect: Part of Hoboken's and London's Vision Zero approach; pedestrian survival probability is far higher in a 20 mph than a 30+ mph impact.
